name: Lucan Mott
equipment: Ballistic weave dinner jacket, midnight blue, tailored
A Gala invitation in the name of Lucan Devereaux-Mott, heir to a Lunar shipping fortune that does not exist
Three changes of evening dress and one steward's uniform
Disguise kit and a voice modulator the size of a breath mint
A pack of real playing cards, marked
features: Specialist (Human (Specialist): +2 Charisma, +1 Dexterity, one extra skill proficiency: Perception)
Silver Tongue (expertise in Deception and Persuasion)
Rally (bonus action: an ally who can hear him gains 1d6+3 temporary HP and may end being frightened; 3 uses per long rest)
Read the Room (after 1 minute of conversation, learn one goal, fear or lie of the person he is talking to; his Insight against their Deception)
Criminal Contact (Criminal feature: a reliable fence and message drop on Caloris High, and a name that opens doors in the inner system's underworld)

personality.traits: I am exactly who you'd like me to be, and I'll have worked out who that is before you finish saying hello. When I'm nervous I get more charming, which is how you can tell.
personality.ideals: Everybody is running a con. Mine are just honest about it.
personality.bonds: Eight years ago I was briefly engaged to Perpetua Ostrander's grandson, under another name, for the money. I left before the wedding because I liked him too much. She never knew who I really was. She might recognise me now.
personality.flaws: I fall a little in love with every mark. Then I feel terrible. Then I take their money anyway.

appearance: A beautiful, slightly worn man of thirty-four with dark curls, a lazy smile and a face that is somehow always familiar to the person looking at it. He wears evening dress as if he was born in it, which he wasn't. He was born in a hab-block on Ceres to a fishmonger and a tax inspector, and he has never told anyone, ever.
backstory: Lucan Mott, which is the name he was born with and the one he uses least, has been a Lunar heir, an Earth diplomat's son, a Venusian cloud-city architect and, for eleven glorious months, the fiancé of Teodor Ostrander, Perpetua's grandson. He walked away from that last one with nothing, which he has never managed to explain to himself. He specialises in the rich and in long cons, and he has a rule about never going back to a mark, which he is breaking for sixty thousand credits. His job aboard the Aubade is to sit at the top table at the opening dinner, keep Perpetua Ostrander talking and hold her attention while someone else takes her hand.
